configurations.name: Debug SRAM (SWD load, no bootloader)
configurations.//: SRAM image (no bootloader): reset boots the chip from flash, so we halt, write the program into SRAM, then load SP/PC from the SRAM vector table (0x24000000) to jump into our image. The firmware then self-installs SCB->VTOR = 0x24000000 in SystemInit (enabled by the VECT_TAB_SRAM define on the arm-debug build in CMakeLists.txt) so SysTick/audio IRQs vector to OUR SRAM handlers — without VECT_TAB_SRAM, SystemInit would point VTOR at the bootloader's flash table and interrupts misroute, which breaks stepping. The H750 will not auto-boot this image after a power cycle — expected for a debug session.
configurations.//dbgmcu: DBGMCU_CR (0x5C001004) |= 0x7 keeps the D1 debug clock alive through SLEEP/STOP/STANDBY so halting in the audio DMA ISR (and the main loop's System::Delay idle) doesn't wedge the SWD link — without this, a long pause at a breakpoint leaves the part unrecoverable on continue and forces a probe power-cycle.
configurations.//restart: Restart must do a full relaunch: reset+halt resets the audio/SAI/DMA peripherals and clocks, and 'load' rewrites a clean SRAM image (.data/.bss back to init values). Just re-pointing SP/PC into a dirtied, still-running image hangs in peripheral re-init — that was the regression.

configurations.name: Attach (bootloader-launched app)
configurations.//: DFU-flash the deploy build, let the bootloader launch it, then attach to inspect/step the running SRAM app. Symbols come from the deploy ELF; no program is written.
